name: MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 AI (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube
description: The MoYu AoLong 3x3 V5 AI (Magnetic, MagLev, Ball-Core, UV Coated) - Bluetooth Smart Cube is the only AoLong V5 AI with a gyroscope core. It tracks your motion for real-time feedback and 3D replays of your turning, and pairs that core with MagLev elasticity and an 8-magnet ball-core for 88 magnets in all.
features: Gyroscope magnetic core: Precise motion tracking sends real-time data to the WCU CUBE app, including a 3D replay of your turning technique.
Ball-core alignment: Eight magnets inside the ball core pull each layer into position for stronger magnetic alignment.
MagLev elasticity: Repelling magnets replace springs for a fast, smooth turning feel.
Train and compete in the app: Auto timing, AI coaching, post-solve analysis reports, ranked PvP, and team battles.
Smart charging case: Charges and stores the cube in one case.
8 MagLev elasticity levels: Rotate counterclockwise; the indicator shows the elasticity level.
